candidate_rules.trajectory_scale: fallback_value_range / (n * episode_horizon); included as a control because terminal goal-entry dynamics can make goal_local_variation a structural discontinuity rather than critic noise

calibration.goal_local_variation: Maximum absolute one-step critic change on the first transition into the goal set in each fallback trial.
calibration.fallback_value_range: Maximum critic value minus minimum critic value over both endpoints of first-hitting fallback trajectories, truncated immediately after their first transition into the goal set.

development_evaluation.checkpoint_subset: Reward-stratified low, mid, and high representatives selected independently from the completed legacy checkpoint sweep.
development_evaluation.selection_rule: Among candidate (rule, n) pairs meeting the pre-specified goal-reaching constraint, maximize the environment-balanced mean paired reward improvement; break a practically tied plateau toward its central n and the more conservative rule. Freeze both rule and n before the full rerun.

deterministic_gate_ablation.scope: One checkpoint and environment fixed before inspecting ablation outcomes.
deterministic_gate_ablation.rationale: The late underwater-drone checkpoint is the closest match to the motivating goal-reaching deployment task and is fixed independently of the ablation outcome.
